findings.text: This report is an April 30, 2025 addendum to the earlier Amazon Nova Family of Models technical report.

source.quote: This report was published on April 30, 2025 as an addendum to “The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card” [5].

notes: Technical report/model card addendum (8 PDF pages). No numeric safety eval scores: BOLD, WILDCHAT non-toxic, StrongReject, WMDP, ProtocolQA, BioLP Bench, SECURE, CTIBench, CyberMetric, Cybench, and RE-Bench are named without results. CTIBench/CyberMetric would be skipped as defensive threat-intel Q&A under pilot rules even if scored. Skipped capability Table 1 and runtime Table 2 (MMLU, GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, MATH-500, MBXP, BigCodeBench Hard, IFEval, MMMU, OCRBench-v2, CharXiv, TallyQA, EgoSchema, SimpleQA, BFCL V3, ScreenSpot, SWE-bench Verified, TTFT/OTPS). April 30, 2025 is the report publication date, not a model release date. Veracity named as an RAI dimension but no hallucination/honesty behavioral claim. Internal Amazon red team and Amazon security team are not listed as testers.
